title: Identify schools in California that either opened after 1990 or have no clo
question: Identify schools in California that either opened after 1990 or have no closure date, offer a grade span that includes high school (i.e., ends with '12'), and are associated with both FRPM and SAT data. For these schools, calculate the SAT excellence rate and the eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17. Return the school name, district, county, both rates, and the number of test takers, but only for schools where the SAT excellence rate exceeds 0.1 and the free meal rate exceeds 0.2.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
  s."XCL_046" AS district,
  s."XCL_045" AS county,
  CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" AS sat_excellence_rate,
  f."XCL_026" AS free_meal_rate,
  t."XCL_036" AS num_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
WHERE s."XCL_052" = 'CA'
  AND (s."XCL_061" > '1990-12-31' OR s."XCL_062" IS NULL)
  AND s."XCL_074" LIKE '%12'
  AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.1
  AND f."XCL_026" > 0.2
